graphql.query: query Query_CasinoGames($input: CasinoGameSearchRequest!) { casinoGames(input: $input) { __typename hasContent isFirst isLast page size sort totalElements totalPages } }

request.description:
List of available casino games. Search is based on casino game filters. You must provided casino game filter id,
for example live-games. System contains following automatic game filters:
- all               - contains all available games for the site.
- favourite         - contains user's favourite game selections.
- recent            - contains user's recent games what he/she has played or launched.
- live              - returns live games.
- {provider-id}     - for every provider there is name provider-id specific game group such as pragmatic-play or evolution-games.

Generated automatically from GraphQL introspection.

Arguments:
- `input: CasinoGameSearchRequest!` (required)

Configure generated variables before running this request.
